description: A hooded man in a dark embroidered coat leans over a wooden table and presses a seal into a wax disc on a document tied with cord. Four other men in dark hoods and caps stand around him. A lit candle, quill pens, ink pots and rolled scrolls sit on the table, with illegible scribbled lines on the papers. Behind them are Gothic vaulted stone arches and stone columns in a dim room. The dress and room suggest the medieval or early modern period. The painting fills the frame edge to edge.
